dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト) - GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL based system used in Japanese medical clinics
evidence: SELECT ... ASSIGN RECE01PARA / RECE44PARA etc (OpenCOBOL file assignment style)
Fixed format, no IBM-specific extensions visible

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing - monthly billing detail file creation for re-examination and self-pay receipts, point-count column editing
purpose.summary: ORCR0460 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that creates monthly business detail files for re-examination and self-pay receipts. It reads indexed receipt files (RECE41, RECE44, RECE45, RECE46), edits point/count columns, and writes output including an error file. The program handles examination counts, drug/device detail editing, and various medical procedure code classifications.

notable_features: 17 COPY statements with REPLACING for file record definitions
Multiple indexed files with DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access
Japanese EUC/Shift-JIS encoded comments (latin-1 decoded as mojibake)
No COMP-3 usage despite numeric processing
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Detailed revision history in comments spanning 2000-2004
verdict.notes: Comments are encoded in Japanese (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS), decoded as latin-1 resulting in mojibake. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 128645 bytes (2792 lines total). The file is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA (日医標準レセプトソフト) system. GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL dialect inferred from project context and file assignment style rather than explicit compiler directives.
